subject: Co-host Demo Track at Integration Summit — Redwood x CloudSpark
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@cloudspark.io>
To: rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: events@cloudspark.io, tom.bowers@integratek.com
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invitation — Integration Summit demo track (Oct 7)

Hi Rachel,

Hope you're well — we loved the Redwood demo at Developer Day and would like to invite Redwood to co-host the "Integration & Runtime" demo track at our Integration Summit in San Francisco on Oct 7. The slot is a 30-minute segment (20 min live demo + 10 min moderated Q&A).

Quick overview: CloudSpark will handle sponsorship logistics and attendee registration; we ask partners to provide a demo slide deck, a short bio for the speaker, and a 1-paragraph blurb for the event page. Sponsorship includes two exhibitor passes and a shared logo placement on the event site. There is a modest sponsorship fee but we can apply partner credits.

Would Redwood be interested? If yes, can you confirm:
- A speaker (name/title)
- Any system access/AV needs (laptop + internet is standard)
- Any pre-recording preferences

If it's helpful I can send a partnership outline and deadlines.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing from you.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, CloudSpark
Lena Ortiz | CloudSpark

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@cloudspark.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation — Integration Summit demo track (Oct 7)

Hi Lena — thanks for the invite and congrats on the event lineup. Redwood would be excited to participate.

Quick answers:
- Speaker: I propose Priyom Das (Senior Solutions Engineer) to run the live demo; Priyom — can you confirm availability?
- AV: standard laptop + HDMI adapter; we may request a wired ethernet drop for stability if available.
- Pre-record: we prefer live but can provide a 5-minute pre-recorded segment as a backup.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in Marissa to coordinate co-marketing copy and logo assets.
- Please send the partnership outline and deadlines you mentioned, and any sponsorship agreement to review.

Can you also confirm the expected audience profile (platform engineers, product leads, ISVs) and whether the session will be recorded/published? That will help us tailor the demo.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invitation — Integration Summit demo track (Oct 7)

Marissa — forwarding Lena's note. TL;DR: CloudSpark offered a 30-min slot (20 demo + 10 AMA). We should take it, but I want a short co-marketing plan and clarity on any sponsor fees (Lena said partner credits possible).

Ask: can you draft the event blurb and confirm if we want Redwood logo + "demo partner" placement? Also confirm whether to request a waived sponsor fee (usual play: we offer a short case study in exchange).

Priyom — please share 2 possible demo angles (1. "low-latency integration" + 2. "cost-optimized deployment patterns") and confirm speaker availability Oct 7.

Attaching: Speaker_Bios.docx (put together a short bio for Priyom and a backup speaker).

Thanks — R

Attachment: Speaker_Bios.docx

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@cloudspark.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, events@cloudspark.io
Date: Fri, 22 Aug 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invitation — Integration Summit demo track (Oct 7) — Confirmed speaker + assets

Hi Lena — great to align. Confirming Redwood will take the demo slot. A few attachments and next steps below.

Speaker: Priyom Das, Senior Solutions Engineer
- Bio & headshot: attached (Speaker_Bios.docx)
- Demo title: "Serving at Scale: Integrating Redwood for predictable latency and cost"

Attachments:
- CloudSpark_Redwood_DemoDeck_v3.pdf (20-slide deck with demo flow)
- Draft_CoPromote_MOU.pdf (one-page MOU with co-marketing commitments and logo usage)
- Speaker_Bios.docx (short bios + headshot links)

Mutual action plan (high level):
1) You add our speaker to the event page and confirm recording permissions by 2025-08-26.
2) CloudSpark confirms exhibitor passes and any sponsor fee/credit details by 2025-08-29.
3) We finalize deck and run a dry run on Oct 1 (Priyom + CloudSpark AV).
4) We publish co-branded blog post within two weeks of the event and share promo copy by 2025-09-15.

Logistics/requests:
- We request a wired ethernet drop at the demo booth and AV check 30 min before the session.
- Please send the finalized sponsor agreement (we reviewed the attached MOU as a starting point).

Shared links: event agenda: https://events.cloudspark.io/integration-summit-2025/agenda, shared assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C_Redwood-CloudSpark.

If the timeline and MOU look good, happy to sign the co-promote MOU and proceed. I'll route the DocuSign once we have final sponsor fee confirmation.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

Attachments: CloudSpark_Redwood_DemoDeck_v3.pdf, Draft_CoPromote_MOU.pdf, Speaker_Bios.docx
